-- Expand public local-HTML sample views to the 1,000-row queue and add a
-- convenience v2 view with uploaded Sellpia image metadata.

create or replace view public.match_candidate_queue_sample
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  queue_id,
  source_batch_id,
  source_channel,
  source_row_no,
  channel_product_code,
  channel_option_code,
  channel_product_name,
  channel_option_name,
  channel_seller_code,
  channel_stock,
  channel_status,
  best_sellpia_product_code,
  best_sellpia_sku_code,
  best_sellpia_product_name,
  best_sellpia_option_name,
  match_tier,
  match_score,
  match_reason,
  duplicate_candidate_count,
  duplicate_risk,
  review_required,
  recommended_action,
  source_candidate_key,
  created_at,
  updated_at
from review.match_candidate_queue
where source_batch_id in (
  'sample_smartstore_100',
  'sample_makeshop_100',
  'sample_smartstore_500',
  'sample_makeshop_500'
)

create or replace view public.match_candidate_details_sample
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  d.detail_id,
  d.queue_id,
  d.candidate_rank,
  d.sellpia_product_code,
  d.sellpia_sku_code,
  d.sellpia_product_name,
  d.sellpia_option_name,
  d.match_score,
  d.match_reason,
  d.risk_flags,
  d.created_at
from review.match_candidate_details d
join review.match_candidate_queue q
  on q.queue_id = d.queue_id
where q.source_batch_id in (
  'sample_smartstore_100',
  'sample_makeshop_100',
  'sample_smartstore_500',
  'sample_makeshop_500'
)

create or replace view public.mapping_matrix_review_sample_v2
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  q.*,
  case
    when q.source_channel = 'smartstore' and q.match_tier = 'AUTO_APPROVE_CANDIDATE' then 'STOCK_MATCH'
    when q.source_channel = 'smartstore' and q.match_tier = 'NO_MATCH' then 'STOCK_SMARTSTORE_NOT_FOUND'
    when q.source_channel = 'smartstore' then 'STOCK_HOLD_REVIEW'
    else null
  end as stock_compare_status,
  case
    when q.match_tier = 'AUTO_APPROVE_CANDIDATE' then 'AUTO_APPROVE_SAFE'
    when q.match_tier = 'FAST_REVIEW' then 'FAST_REVIEW'
    when q.match_tier = 'NO_MATCH' then 'HOLD_RISKY'
    else q.match_tier
  end as auto_approval_tier,
  i.original_file_name as sellpia_image_file_name,
  i.storage_public_url as sellpia_image_url,
  i.upload_status as sellpia_image_upload_status,
  (i.storage_public_url is not null) as has_sellpia_image
from public.match_candidate_queue_sample q
left join public.sellpia_product_images_public i
  on i.p_code = q.best_sellpia_sku_code
 and i.upload_status = 'uploaded'
grant select on public.match_candidate_queue_sample to anon, authenticated
grant select on public.match_candidate_details_sample to anon, authenticated
grant select on public.mapping_matrix_review_sample_v2 to anon, authenticated
